info.title: EIAMS API
info.description: Provisional design-first API contract derived from the EIAMS PRD 2.0, Schema v5, canonical BDM, and approved decisions including D-AUTH-01, D-LIFE-01, D-MAT-01, D-UOM-01, D-INV-READ-01, and D-IAR-01 (issue-line existing-asset references). Material-unit conversion factors use exact DECIMAL(18,6) JSON strings. Importable into Apidog for mocking and frontend generation. Backend ratification is required before production integration.

license.name: Proprietary - General Authority for Oversight and Inspection

servers.description: Relative EIAMS v1 base path; configure the Apidog environment host separately.

get.description: Returns the material-specific alternative-unit conversions to that material's server-owned base unit. One common unit name, such as Carton, never implies a global factor.

200.description: Material unit conversions, including inactive historical conversions

post.description: Requires catalog.manage. The server derives the material base unit and rejects an inactive or out-of-scope material/unit, a base-unit/self conversion, or an active duplicate for the same material and fromUnit.

put.summary: Update or deactivate material unit conversion
put.description: Requires catalog.manage and the current rowVersion. The server rejects stale versions, invalid scope/status, and any factor overwrite after the conversion has been used in a posted document. A used conversion may be deactivated; create a replacement instead. DELETE is intentionally unsupported so historical document snapshots remain auditable.

parameters.name: lowStockState
parameters.description: Server-computed low-stock state applied before sorting and pagination.

get.description: Effective scope and filters are applied before deterministic server sorting and pagination. Default order: warehouse display name ascending, material display name ascending, balanceId ascending.
Returns 404 for both an unknown balance and a balance outside the effective session scope. No client-authored scope parameter is accepted.
Effective scope and filters are applied before deterministic server sorting and pagination. Default order: postedAt descending, movementId descending.

bearerAuth.description: Short-lived access JWT held only in frontend memory and sent in the Authorization header.

refreshCookie.name: eiams_refresh
refreshCookie.description: Rotating host-only refresh credential. Production responses set Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict, and Path=/api/v1/auth; JavaScript must never read or persist it.

RefreshCookie.description: Sets, rotates, or expires the host-only eiams_refresh cookie. Production attributes: Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict; Path=/api/v1/auth.

InventoryBalanceSortBy.name: sortBy
InventoryBalanceSortBy.description: Primary balance sort field. Stable warehouse/material/balanceId tie-breakers are server-owned.

StockMovementSortBy.name: sortBy
StockMovementSortBy.description: Primary movement sort field. Stable postedAt/movementId tie-breakers are server-owned.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Unique UUID for retry-safe action execution.

AuthUnauthorized.description: Authentication failed, access expired, or refresh session expired

AuthForbidden.description: Authenticated session lacks the permission or requested scope

Conflict.description: State, idempotency, or optimistic concurrency conflict

DocumentActionResult.description: Authoritative document and immutable event after a lifecycle action

LifecycleConflict.description: Lifecycle state or row-version conflict; no transition was applied

NullableUuid.description: UUID when an entity-backed scope applies; null for Enterprise scope.

InventoryLowStockState.description: Server-computed low-stock state using the active warehouse material setting minQuantity.

thresholdQuantity.description: Active minQuantity used for comparison; null when alerting is unconfigured or disabled.

InventoryLowStockProjection.description: Low when quantity is less than or equal to an active non-null minQuantity; Sufficient when greater; NotConfigured for missing/null settings; Disabled for inactive settings.

ConsumableMaterialPolicy.description: D-MAT-01: Consumables are quantity-tracked and have no asset number. Issuing them closes warehouse responsibility; no custody row is created.

DurableMaterialPolicy.description: D-MAT-01: Durable operational-custody materials never have an asset number. Quantity tracking uses MaterialQuantity custody; serial tracking uses a non-asset TrackedUnit custody. The v1 snapshot represents TrackedUnit IDs in document-line and custody payloads only; a generic tracked-unit picker/lifecycle endpoint requires separate backend/API ratification.

AssetMaterialPolicy.description: D-MAT-01: Fixed assets are individually serial-tracked, must receive an institutional asset number, create Asset records, and are issued through Asset custody. A manufacturer serial number remains optional on the Asset record.

PositiveDecimal18_6.description: Exact positive DECIMAL(18,6) transport value, encoded as a JSON string so JavaScript clients do not lose precision. Accepted grammar: `0.<1-6 fractional digits containing at least one non-zero digit>` or `<1-12 non-zero-leading integer digits>[.<1-6 fractional digits>]`; no sign, exponent, thousands separator, or leading zero is accepted. Minimum is `0.000001`; maximum is `999999999999.999999`. Examples: `12`, `12.000000`, `0.250000`, and `999999999999.999999`.

MaterialUnitConversion.description: A material-specific conversion from an alternative unit directly to the material's server-owned base unit. A unit name never carries a global factor: for example, Carton may equal 12 Pieces for one material and 6 Boxes for another.

baseUnit.description: The material base unit derived by the server; it is never client-supplied for a conversion.

factor.description: One fromUnit equals factor multiplied by the material base-unit quantity.

status.description: Inactive archives a conversion; no DELETE operation exists.

usedInPostedDocuments.description: Server-owned historical-use indicator. When true, the factor cannot be overwritten; deactivate and create a replacement if packaging changes.

MaterialUnitConversionCreateRequest.description: Creates one active alternative unit for the material in the URL. Do not supply materialId or baseUnitId: the server derives both. The server enforces one active record per material/fromUnit and rejects self/base-unit, inactive, out-of-scope, and duplicate inputs.

MaterialUnitConversionUpdateRequest.description: Uses optimistic concurrency. For an unused conversion the factor may be changed. For a conversion used in any posted document, the server permits only the Active-to-Inactive archival transition with the current rowVersion; a changed factor is rejected. fromUnitId and baseUnitId are immutable and are never supplied.

factor.description: The server rejects a changed factor value after historical use.

conversionId.description: Immutable conversion snapshot identifier. Null only when the selected unit is the material base unit.

conversionFactor.description: Immutable exact factor captured when the line is created or posted. Base-unit lines use the string `1.000000`.

assetInputs.description: Required one-per-unit for Asset material lines; each resulting Asset has an institutional asset number and an optional manufacturer serial number.

issuedAssetIds.description: Projected on Issue Asset-kind lines: ids of the specific existing assets this line issued (resolved from the draft's assetIds and frozen on posting). Null/absent for non-Issue or non-Asset lines.

trackedUnits.description: Created non-asset durable units for a Durable + Serial receiving line. This field is never used for Consumable or Asset material lines.

conversionId.description: Optional selected alternative conversion for a draft. Null or omitted denotes the material base unit. The server derives the authoritative snapshot and rejects an inactive, out-of-scope, mismatched, or non-material conversion.

conversionFactor.description: Optional exact-string draft preview only. The server derives and persists the immutable factor; it never trusts a client override.

baseQuantity.description: Optional draft preview only. The server derives and persists quantity multiplied by the immutable factor; it never trusts a client override.

assetInputs.description: Allowed only for Asset material lines. The server creates one Asset per input and requires an institutional asset number after posting.

assetIds.description: Allowed only for Issue lines whose material is Asset-kind. References existing assets to issue: every id must resolve to an Asset that is currently InStock and belongs to the line's material in the source warehouse, and the count must equal the line quantity. Mutually exclusive with assetInputs.

trackedUnitInputs.description: Allowed only for Receiving lines whose material policy is Durable + Serial. It creates non-asset TrackedUnit records and the input count must equal the line quantity.

TrackedUnitInput.description: A supplier/manufacturer serial for one Durable + Serial unit. It is explicitly not an asset number and does not create an Asset record.

AssetInput.description: Input for one Asset material unit. assetNumber may be supplied by an authorized user or allocated by the server during posting; every resulting Asset has a non-null institutional asset number. serialNumber is an optional manufacturer identifier.

allowed.description: True exactly when presentation is Enabled.

DocumentLifecycleEvent.description: Immutable actual lifecycle transition. Created omits fromStatus; draft edits are audit details, not lifecycle events.

assetNumber.description: Immutable institutional asset identifier. It is mandatory on every Asset record and is distinct from the optional manufacturer serial number.

TrackedUnit.description: A durable operational item tracked individually by serial number. It is not a fixed asset, has no asset number, and can be the subject of custody. This snapshot exposes tracked units through document-line and custody payloads; it deliberately does not add an unratified generic list, lookup, or lifecycle endpoint.

MaterialQuantityCustody.description: Custody of a positive base-unit quantity for a Durable + Quantity material. It never creates an Asset record or asset number and supports partial transfer/return by quantity.

TrackedUnitCustody.description: Custody of one Durable + Serial TrackedUnit. It is individually traceable by serial number but is not an Asset and has no asset number.

Custody.description: D-MAT-01 custody subject union. Consumables are excluded. Asset is for fixed assets; MaterialQuantity and TrackedUnit are for durable operational-custody materials.

MaterialQuantityCustodyMutationRequest.description: Assign or transfer a positive quantity of a Durable + Quantity material. For transfer, the target custody route identifies the source row and the quantity may be less than its active quantity.

TrackedUnitCustodyMutationRequest.description: Assign or transfer one existing Durable + Serial TrackedUnit. It is distinct from an Asset and no asset number is accepted.

CustodyMutationRequest.description: D-MAT-01 polymorphic custody command. The server validates that the chosen subject type matches the catalog material policy and, on transfer, matches the custody addressed by the route. The command does not create or discover TrackedUnit records; a generic tracked-unit selection/lifecycle surface remains outside this provisional v1 route set pending backend/API ratification.

ActionPresentation.description: Server-authoritative presentation. Hidden is unauthorized or unsupported; Disabled is visible but blocked; Enabled remains subject to mutation-time revalidation.

LifecycleActorSnapshot.description: Authorized historical actor snapshot; clients do not join current user or employee data.

adjustmentId.description: Authoritative InventoryAdjustment route identity. Present when documentType is Adjustment; absent for WarehouseDocument routes.

events.description: Complete immutable collection ordered by occurredAt then eventId, oldest first.

DocumentActionResult.description: Authoritative, idempotently replayable result of a successful generic lifecycle action.

AdjustmentReverseResult.description: Atomic ordinary-adjustment reversal result. Disposal is not reversible.
